objectpackh7memorialRumor0.text: I hear the H7 Memorial Advanced Exchange is an odd place: bring in troops of the seven old factions, like Castle or Rampart, and you can swap them for H7 troops of the same faction and level—usually free, as many times as you like.

objectpackh7memorialRumor1.text: Troops shrunk or downgraded? Don't cry just yet. Take a stroll through the Exchange and they'll come out looking just like before.

objectpackh7memorialRumor2.text: A mage told me you can visit the H7 Memorial Advanced Magic Academy again and again—but without a spellbook you can't even get through the door.

objectpackh7memorialRumor3.text: Legend has it the H7 Memorial Shrine has a full army guarding the gate. Win, then come back with one stack each of upgraded troops of levels 1 to 7 from a single faction, and you'll permanently learn that people's ultimate ability—but each lord gets only one chance in a lifetime.
